payload.claim: DESIGN.md (the section this change implements, b-7c88f8) states a criterion still without a usable answer 'is an `error`. It blocks nothing, and the REVIEW line and the pull request name it.' This diff makes the REVIEW line name it (`_unasked_tail`), but `_not_covered` here still only checks `e.get("error")` on each wrong-version entry (saffron/report/pr_body.py:691-692), never the new `unasked` key the diff adds to individual criterion-probe and wrong-version dicts. So a task whose only gap is one or more unasked pairs renders no 'Not covered' line at all, and when nothing else is wrong the fallback at this line asserts '- Nothing: every gate and criterion above was judged and could block, and every finding reached the implementer' — which is false for exactly the case this change introduces (an unjudged, unasked criterion).
